WinoAccount_ConsentNavigationDescription: Review the single account-wide permission used by Wino Intelligence.
WinoAccount_IntelligenceConsentDescripti: Allow Wino to send message content to its AI providers when you request summarize, translate, or rewrite. These on-demand requests are not stored as mailbox Intelligence data on Wino servers.
WinoAccount_IntelligenceConsentPolicyNot: Review the policy before you allow Wino Intelligence to process your data. You can revoke this permission at any time.
WinoAccount_IntelligenceConsentDisableMe: This turns off Intelligence for every mailbox and immediately clears local Intelligence data. Wino will also delete all stored Intelligence data from its servers. If cleanup cannot finish immediately, access stays revoked and deletion continues in the background.
WinoAccount_IntelligenceConsentDeletionP: Your Intelligence data is being deleted. Access stays disabled until cleanup is complete.
WinoAccount_IntelligenceConsentDeletionF: Wino could not finish deleting all Intelligence data. Access stays disabled and cleanup will be retried.
WinoAccount_IntelligenceConsentNotGrante: Allow AI provider access to use summarize, translate, rewrite, and optional mailbox indexing.

WinoIntelligence_AccountRequired: A Wino Account and a monthly subscription are required. Pricing is shown before checkout.

WinoAccount_TransportConsentDescription: This permission applies to your Wino Account, not individual mailboxes. It allows eligible Wino Intelligence features to send requested data to approved service providers that do not retain it.
WinoAccount_TransportConsentPolicyNotice: This account-wide permission allows Wino to transport data for eligible on-demand features. It does not grant mailbox processing permission.
WinoAccount_ProcessConsentPolicyNotice: This permission allows Wino Intelligence to process and store intelligence data for {0}.
WinoAccount_ProcessConsentBulkPolicyNoti: This permission allows Wino Intelligence to process and store intelligence data for every mailbox listed on this page.
WinoAccount_TransportConsentDisableMessa: On-demand Intelligence features cannot send data for processing until you allow data transport again. Mailbox processing permissions are not changed.
WinoAccount_ProcessConsentDisableMessage: Disabling data processing for {0} immediately deletes its Intelligence data from Wino servers and this device.
WinoAccount_ProcessConsentDisableAllMess: Disabling all mailbox processing permissions immediately deletes Intelligence data for every listed mailbox.
